# Settings

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

The network's rules and this device's own choices, in tabs.

## What is on the screen

1. Sections. Each desk sees its own sections, such as Rules, Alerts, Display and You.
2. Save rule changes. Rule changes wait here until you Save, and every save is recorded. Discard drops them.
3. Display. Theme, row density and the other choices for this device. They save at once.
4. Your desk. What your screens include and the shift you are on.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
